title: Slow Building
description: Slows down placing certain blocks: hold right-click, watch the progress bar, then the block is placed.
body:
# **Slow Building**

Makes placing certain blocks deliberate: hold right-click, watch the progress bar, then the block is placed.

Licensed under the MIT License.

Notice: This mod was made with AI. If you don't like AI, don't use it.

**Features**

    Hold to place — Configured blocks cannot be placed instantly; you must hold right-click (main hand) until the bar fills.
    Progress bar — A grey bar under the crosshair shows placement progress.
    Look-away cancel — Turn your crosshair off the target block face and placement is cancelled (even if you keep holding right-click).
    Building sounds — Scaffolding-style hit sounds while holding and a place sound when the block is set.
    Server-friendly — On dedicated servers, the server config is authoritative and is synced to clients when they join.
